name: RustFS 1.0.7
body:
<!-- rustfs-generated-release-notes: managed; remove this marker before manual edits -->
## What's Changed
* fix(storage): backport scanner recovery and ordered shard reads by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9512
* fix(scanner): resume wide directory scans on release 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9523
* fix(scanner): backport usage and recovery fixes to 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9531
* fix(storage): bound delete recovery and guard legacy residue cleanup by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9534
* fix(storage): backport replacement heal and scanner fixes to 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9533
* fix(ilm): continue tier recovery past unreadable objects in 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9539
* fix(iam): backport Console STS password rotation to 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9536
* fix(admin): report inventory coverage and cluster scanner activity on 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9540
* fix(scanner): preserve discovery progress across owner cancellation by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9546
* feat(scanner): expose durable bucket scan progress by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9548
* fix(scanner): restore release CI and preserve admin response contracts by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9555
* fix(scanner): preserve durable progress on wide and changing buckets by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9552
* fix(heal): retry busy bucket repairs after a node restart by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9562
* fix(scanner): reuse sealed page names during directory enumeration by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9564
* fix(scanner): fence prefix usage cache fills across invalidation by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9566
* fix(scanner): preserve inventory and maintenance coverage by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9567
* fix(scanner): recertify legacy usage after cold restart by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9573
* fix(scanner): resume checkpoints and expose partial progress by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9583
* fix(scanner): preserve checkpoint coverage across handoffs by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9587
* fix(scanner): preserve completed usage and publish initial progress by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9592
* fix(decommission): keep scanner progress on its owning set by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9603
* fix(sts): validate root credentials on 1.0.7 startup by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9604
* fix(sts): validate root credentials and report parent access denials (1.0.7) by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9605
* fix(ecstore): make release directory walks iterative by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9608
* fix(scanner): backport tier registry replan to 1.0.7 by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9616
* fix(sts): backport inline session policy Id support to 1.0.7 by @GatewayJ in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9614
* fix(kms,sse): backport KMS and SSE fixes to 1.0.7 by @reatang in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9613
* fix(scanner): walk directories with an explicit stack by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9623
* fix(replication): verify probe cleanup against target versions by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9624
* fix(s3): restore 1.0.7 compatibility and batch delete correctness by @cxymds in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9622
* fix(ecstore): backport bulk delete repair to 1.0.7 by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9633
* fix(ecstore): gate rebalance test fixtures on test-util by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9634


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.6...1.0.7
